name: anneal
description: Audits how easy an existing repository is for an agent to find its way around — map file, toolchain version, names, layout, build output, check commands — then proposes a layout you approve and migrates in small commits, each checked against the project's own tests.

interface.shortDescription: Lay a repository out so an agent stops searching for it
interface.longDescription: Audits what makes an agent search, read or guess more than it needs to in a repository — no map file, no declared toolchain version, duplicate or generic names, build output in search results — then proposes a layout you approve and migrates it in small commits, each checked against the project's own tests.
defaultPrompt: Audit this repository for what makes it hard to navigate.
